config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT error_type AS Error, round(n) AS Count, round(n * 86400 / greatest(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime), 1)) AS `Count/Day`,
    round(ifNull(100 * (cur - prev) / nullIf(prev, 0), 0), 1) AS `Count vs prev %`
FROM (SELECT error_type, sum(errors) AS n FROM (SELECT t, error_type, errors FROM hud_otel.function_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(function, $function) AND $__filter(flow, $flow)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, error_type, errors FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(function, $function) AND $__filter(flow, $flow)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, error_type, errors FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(function, $function) AND $__filter(flow, $flow)) GROUP BY error_type) AS m
LEFT JOIN (SELECT error_type, sum(errors) AS cur FROM (SELECT error_type, errors FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(function, $function) AND $__filter(flow, $flow)) GROUP BY error_type) AS c USING (error_type)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT error_type, sum(errors) AS prev FROM (SELECT error_type, errors FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(function, $function) AND $__filter(flow, $flow)) GROUP BY error_type) AS p USING (error_type)
WHERE n > 0 AND error_type != '' ORDER BY Count DESC

WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,

WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
